When using Chat Heads 1.2.8 on Minecraft 26.3, the client crashes as soon as I type `@` while entering a command.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Launch Minecraft 26.3 with Fabric and Chat Heads 1.2.8.
2. Join a world or server.

/tp @

issues.title: Compatibility with Caxton
issues.body:
I know it could be difficult, but I still wonder the possibility to work with [Caxton](https://modrinth.com/mod/caxton).

Caxton is a mod that modifies core shaders and text renderers, to provide smoother fonts.

When using the new default "Before Name" render mode, which modifies text renderers as well, the chat heads will just not render. (But old "Before Line" works fine)

## Steps To Reproduce
1. Install Caxton and launch the game.
